headline.title: Review pull requests on iPhone
headline.body: Open eligible GitHub and GitLab reviews from a compatible Alas app host. Read inline threads, draft comments, submit a review, or send open drafts to an agent.
headline.alt_text: iPhone pull request diff with an inline thread, draft count, Send to Agent, and Submit controls.

also.title: A better plugin store
also.body: Browse Installed, Available, and Updates tabs in the redesigned Plugins settings.

also.title: Workspace checkouts on iPhone
also.body: With a compatible local Mac host, group sessions by workspace and switch repository tools between member repositories.
